Name: (AT) Nano's Retro Style Furniture
Author: NanoIsNotRobot
Description:
[font=Arial][b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]**Brief Introduction**[/size][/color][/b]

This mod provides a set of retro style furniture that is especially compatible with vanilla style, using the AT mode.
The range of furniture types is quite extensive, including cabinets, rugs, tables and chairs, floor-to-ceiling windows, wall decorations, plants, and more.
Hope you will enjoy it!

For Chinese players, you can contact with me on the Chinese media platform [i]Xiaohongshu.[/i]

**Installation&Usage**[/color][/b]
[font=Arial][size=2]
1. Download the two preposed mods: [u]SMAPI[/u] and the [u]Alternative Textures[/u]     
    确保已下载了前置mod SMAPI 和 Alternative Textures

2. Download this mod, unzip it and put it into Stardew Valley's mod foler   
    下载本mod，解压后放入星露谷的mod文件夹内

3. Run the game and  go to Robin's shop to purchase the Paint Bucket Tool   
    进入游戏后，在罗宾的商店购买油漆桶工具

4. Use the Paint Bucket Tool to change furniture's look   
    通过油漆桶修改家具外观

5. For a quick search for this mod's furniture, just input the keyword “[color=#6aa84f]nano[/color]” in the Tool's interface.
    可以修改外观界面输入“nano”关键词快速查找本mod的家具

[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=2]6. The usage of some furniture is a little special, I recommend you to[b][color=#f1c232] read the guidelines in pictures in the head of thispage[/color][/b].
